title: Shoes, Then Jacket
can_do: 说清先穿鞋、再穿夹克的顺序，找到眼前的衣物，完成后报告准备好了。
trigger: Dad asks what is still needed before the park; Child names the shoes-then-jacket order and explains why.
setting: Calmly getting ready for the park on a low bench inside the front door.
essential_props: one dressing set: easy slip-on shoes and an open lightweight jacket

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Almost time for the park. What else do you need?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: First my shoes, then my jacket.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Shoes go on my feet. The jacket goes on top.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Clever. Put your shoes on first.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Shoes are on. Can you help with the jacket?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Shoes and jacket. I'm ready for the park!

replay_cards.title: Wash and eat
replay_cards.change: Hands need washing before carrying the snack plate
replay_cards.challenge: Say wash first, then carry the plate; wash and dry hands, carry the plate, and say you are ready to eat

replay_cards.title: Pajamas and teeth
replay_cards.change: A pajama top and pants are on the bed. Mom mishears the order and points toward the bathroom for toothbrushing first
replay_cards.challenge: Say, "First I'll put on my pajamas, then brush my teeth." When Mom checks, "Teeth first?", correct her: "No, pajamas first. Teeth come next." Mom accepts the correction and waits while Child gets changed, then helps with brushing; Child reports ready for bed

parent_support: Ask what remains while the actual clothes are within sight and reach; let the child name the order.
Steady easy shoes and help with the open jacket when asked. Keep the sequence unhurried and report readiness only after both steps are complete.
